script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: NEW LEASE ON LIFE

INT. OFFICE - DAY

JAMES, a disgruntled 45-YEAR-OLD accountant, sits in a mundane, beige cubicle surrounded by stacks of paperwork.

JAMES
(sighs)
Another day, another dollar.

His cell phone buzzes with an email notification. He opens the email to reveal an invitation for an interview with ENVIROTECH, a leading green energy company.

EXT. STREET - DAY

James walks to his old, beat-up car. He takes a deep breath, looks up at the sky, and decides to take a chance on this new opportunity.

INT. ENVIROTECH RECEPTION AREA - DAY

James, clean-shaven and wearing a fresh suit, sits nervously in the reception area. He fiddles with his resume as he waits for his interview.

INT. ENVIROTECH INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

JAMES (CONT'D)
(looking confident)
It's a pleasure to meet you. I understand ENVIROTECH is leading the way in green technology.

JANE, ENVIROTECH HR REP
Yes, we're very proud of that. And I see you have a background in finance. How do you think that will benefit our company?

INT. ENVIROTECH KITCHEN - DAY

James shares a casual lunch with other ENVIROTECH employees. They discuss their roles and their shared passion for making a positive environmental impact.

INT. ENVIROTECH OFFICE - DAY

James receives an offer letter for a finance position. He's elated but also overwhelmed by the change.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James paces in his living room, contemplating the offer. His wife, LUCY, enters the room, concerned.

LUCY
What's going on? You look troubled.

JAMES
(resigned)
I got a job offer. It's a great opportunity, but it's a big change. I don't know if I'm ready.

INT. ENVIROTECH TRAINING ROOM - DAY

James attends his first day of training. He's introduced to new colleagues and learns about ENVIROTECH's green initiatives. James's initial apprehension gives way to excitement as he learns more about the company's mission.

INT. ENVIROTECH OFFICE - DAY

James sits in his new office, feeling a renewed sense of purpose. He begins to adapt to his new role, making progress on projects and forming strong relationships with his colleagues.

INT. ENVIROTECH SOLAR FARM - DAY

James and his team visit ENVIROTECH's solar farm. They discuss the importance of their work in creating a sustainable energy future.

INT. ENVIROTECH RECEPTION AREA - DAY

Months have passed, and James confidently greets new employees. He smiles as he recalls his interview, knowing that taking a chance on ENVIROTECH has given him a new lease on life.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
